question: The United Nations Environment Programme has signed a Memorandum of Understanding with the ______ government to support its 'Majhi Vasundhara' campaign.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Maharashtra__.** 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Government of Maharashtra has joined hands with the United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP)** by signing a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to collaborate on the '**Majhi Vasundhara**' campaign.
 
• The objective of the campaign is to promote sustainable energy usage and environmental development in the state.
 
• The campaign's name translates to '**My Earth**' and is an initiative of the Environment and Climate Change Department, Government of Maharashtra.
 
• Through this partnership, the state government aims to work towards achieving its sustainability goals and ensure a better future for its citizens.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **About the Majhi Vasundhara:**

 
 
• Majhi Vasundhara is an initiative launched by the Government of Maharashtra, India, aimed at promoting sustainable energy use and environmental development in the state.
 
• The campaign is an effort to encourage citizens to take individual and collective action towards protecting the environment and promoting sustainable practices.
 
• The initiative involves various activities such as promoting the use of renewable energy sources, managing waste effectively, and reducing pollution levels.
